description: This PHP source file defines the TruncateTableController class within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically in the functional testing plugin. The controller handles HTTP requests to truncate specified database tables, facilitating test data cleanup during automated testing.

classes.name: TruncateTableController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling requests to truncate database tables during testing. Implements the PublicControllerInterface and extends AbstractController to provide HTTP handling capabilities.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests by retrieving specified table names from request parameters and invoking the TestDataService to truncate those tables, then returns an HTTP response.
